summary: Tested v2.19.7 release: (1) 'In Cinema' movie chip backed by TMDB now_playing (-4 sentinel), (2) Continue Watching tombstone-based delete, (3) release-status accuracy. Backend endpoints VERIFIED via curl. Frontend code review + localStorage-level simulation confirms tombstone logic correct. Full browser UI flow into Home was blocked by the 6-step profile-creation wizard (on-screen keyboard) — the pre-seeded profile flow that worked in prior iterations no longer restores because the cloud backup did not survive between test sessions. Loop-prevention triggered after 3 failed attempts to reach Home.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot easily seed a profile via localStorage because RequireProfile bounces to /profiles unless an active-profile row exists AND the profile row was written before the AuthProvider hydrated vesper-auth-account-v1. Suggest exposing a data-testid on the 'Test' profile card and a URL-param bypass for automated testing, OR keep a static test-user backup on the cloud sync so the 'Restore my profiles' dialog is always reachable.

action_items: MAIN AGENT: Please self-verify the in-browser flow interactively — In Cinema chip should appear first in the movie GenreChips row, tapping it must render the ~20 tiles from /api/tmdb/by-genres/movie?genre_ids=-4, and long-press remove on Continue Watching must survive a full page reload with an entry in onnowtv-cw-removed-v1:<profileId>.
OPTIONAL DX: add data-testid='in-cinema-chip' + data-testid='cw-tile-<id>' + data-testid='cw-remove-<id>' so future automation can drive these flows without long-press mouse events.
critical_code_review_comments: continueWatching.js remove() — CORRECT: showPrefixOf(id) strips ':sxxexx', filters ALL sibling episodes, writes tombstone {prefix: Date.now()} at scoped REMOVED_KEY. syncFromNative Pass 1 & Pass 2 both call isTombstoned(id, p.updatedAt) which returns true unless native updatedAt > tombstone — matches the stated design. upsert() calls clearTombstone(partial.id) on the very first line — fresh playback un-tombstones as required.

release_status.py — CORRECT: only TMDB release type 3 (wide theatrical) sets `theatrical`; types 4/5 (digital/physical) set `digital`; watch-providers check flips hd=True even when digital date missing; cinema window is <=45 days; TTL 6h. Matches the spec (`≤45 days = cinema`, providers → HD).

TabGridView.jsx (~L305) — CORRECT: GenreChips receives ['In Cinema', 'Christmas', ...genreList] for movies, so 'In Cinema' will always render as the FIRST chip. isCinema block (~L70) triggers /api/tmdb/by-genres/movie?genre_ids=-4 when chip selected.
releaseTags.js — CORRECT: in-memory-only cache (no sessionStorage), so tags refresh on every app open as intended.
NIT: releaseTags.js batches 60 ids per flush but doesn't cap total pending — a very tall shelf could accumulate >60 and silently drop the tail. Consider slicing and re-scheduling.

backend_verifications.GET /api/release-status?ids=tt22084616,t: {'tt22084616': {'cinema': true, 'quality': 'cam'}, 'tt33764258': {'cinema': true, 'quality': 'cam'}, 'tt0111161': null} — Spider-Man: Brand New Day + The Odyssey both cinema+cam (both released Dec 2025, no digital yet). Shawshank correctly null (old title, out of window). MATCHES SPEC.

frontend_verifications.code_review_isCinema_fetch: TabGridView.jsx L70 isCinema branch hits /api/tmdb/by-genres/movie?genre_ids=-4 and maps items to tiles with routePath=/resolve/movie/<tmdb_id>.
